definitions.full: H2925. taltelah טַלְטֵלָה noun feminine a hurling , Isa 22:17 , see above Pilpel , literally hurleth thee with a hurling , O man; read perhaps (Du), with a different word-division, הַגֶּבֶר טַלְטֵל (infinitive absolute) טוּר (√ of following; compare Arabic go or hover about, approach , limit, border ).
